text: I need to remember to pack my gear and prepare for my upcoming weekend hiking trip with my buddies to check out the new trail with the rad waterfall, and I should make sure to take lots of pictures during the hike. I also want to keep working on my creative writing and screenwriting projects, keeping the recent milestone of seeing my screenplay bits on the big screen as inspiration whenever I feel nervous about my work. If Joanna ends up signing up for that outdoor writing retreat in the woods, I should remember to remind her to pack a high-grade air purifier for her cabin. I should continue adding inspiring quotes, photos, and little keepsakes to my cork board in my room to maintain my creativity and motivation, especially keeping that special family picture front and center on the board as a daily reminder of their love and encouragement. Additionally, I might want to check in with Nate later to hear how his upcoming gaming party goes in two weeks, since he is organizing it for his tournament friends, old friends, and former teammates, complete with custom controller decorations for everyone attending.
